title: ExplorerCatalogItems
responsibility: Renders module collections and relationships through one shared card, retaining tables only for config variable values.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.category
inputs.description: Collection category, or null for support dependencies. Modules use the shared card; config setting rows retain their value table.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.rows
inputs.description: Required revision-scoped rows to render in their supplied order.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.nav
inputs.description: Required entity navigation retaining the selected branch and revision.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.lens
inputs.description: Required evidence lens supplying screenshots for each visual entity.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required URL prefix used to resolve captured screenshot assets.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.verification
inputs.description: Optional verification visibility, defaulting to true; relationship tabs pass false.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.batch
inputs.description: Optional rows shown per View More step, defaulting to 0 for all rows; relationship tabs pass 4.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name of a batched group and its View More action; defaults to the category or Other when null.

outputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems
outputs.description: Ordered shared module cards, with optional four-entry batching and focus handling; config setting values retain their table.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Function-card argument examples cannot serialize BigInt or circular values.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Serializing a deeply nested function argument example can exceed the runtime stack.

errors.name: Example serialization callback error
errors.description: A getter, proxy or toJSON method on an example can throw while a function invocation is serialized.

errors.name: nav.href callback error
errors.description: An address callback error propagates while rendering a card, table or consumer link.

errors.name: nav.go callback error
errors.description: A navigation callback error propagates when a card, table or consumer link is activated.

errors.name: nav.source callback error
errors.description: A source-opening callback error propagates when a consumer source button is activated.

errors.name: lens.evidence callback error
errors.description: An evidence callback error propagates while resolving a card image or consumer preview.

errors.name: each_key_duplicate
errors.description: Duplicate row identifiers throw when a keyed card list is mounted or updated.
